text:
Ella: PSA: Someone decorated the community lanyard rack with tiny felt crowns. Who is the monarch of badge land?
Samir: Monarch = Bea, obviously. She brought the glitter last week. :crown:
Bea: Noted and humbled. I declare an election. Campaign platform: free stickers and occasional confetti.
Jules: Election rules? Are we doing ballots or interpretive dance?
maintenance-bot: Note: lanyard rack located by main door. No physical modifications that block access per office policy 3.2.
Noah: Ballots please. Also can we have a voter reward? A sticker for voting sounds right.
Ella: Ballots it is. I'll set up a Google Form. One vote per person, write-in allowed. Campaign speeches limited to 30 seconds in the breakroom.
Bea: My speech: "I will protect sticker equity, end clingy lanyard monopolies, and introduce casual badge flair Fridays." Short, passionate.
Samir: I nominate a mascot too. Proposal: tiny foam narwhal.
Jules: Campaign promise: free high-quality Post-its for all. Also I will not let the crown be used for coffee-hatting.
Ella: Voting open for 24h. Maintenance note: crowns must be detachable.
maintenance-bot: Reminder: do not affix items permanently. Failure to comply may result in a gentle scolding and removal.
Noah: Voted for Bea. Also left a tiny doodle on the rack that says "Long Live the Lanyard".
Samir: Voted Jules. Registered my vote with a sticker emoji on the form.
Bea: Voted for Bea (self-vote legally allowed in this tiny democracy).
Jules: Voted. Also bringing foam narwhal tomorrow.
Ella: Poll closed. Results: Bea 4, Jules 2, write-ins 1. Bea is crowned "Regent of Ribbons" until next term.
Bea: Coronation tomorrow at 9:10am. Tiny crown will be placed on the rack for ceremonial handoff. Responsibilities: oversee sticker distribution and mediate clip tangles.
Samir: Does the Regent get a sash? I can make one out of spare lanyards.
Noah: Quick lore entry: "Lanyard Election '26" added to breakroom ledger. We must record the names of the foam narwhal and the crown artisan.
maintenance-bot: Action: check crown attachment weekly.
Ella: Thanks team. Democracy, stickers, and tidy lanyards for all. Please keep crowns removable and crumbs off the rack. :sparkles:
